title: Submarine & Naval Propulsion Components
description: Large-diameter thin-wall cylindrical bushings/bearings with precision bore tolerance, keyway slots, threaded mounting holes
designPrinciples: Material: Grade 5 (Ti-6Al-4V) for propellers, shafts, and structural components. Grade 5 ELI for deep-sea pressure vessels requiring maximum fracture toughness. Grade 7 (Pd alloy) for hot chemical injection lin

Form: Bar/forging stock for shafts and structural components. Investment casting for impeller blades. Ring forgings for flanges. All marine fasteners must be hot-headed + thread rolled with vacuum annealing
engineeringTrends: Process: CNC turning & boring of ID/OD
Process: Precision honing of bearing surface
comparisonNotes: Standards: MIL-T-9046 Grade 5, annealed, magnetic permeability <1.01, 100% dimensional + surface finish inspection
